newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to auction C$400 mln real return bonds.
newsitem.headline: Canada to auction C$400 mln real return bonds.

text.p: The Government of Canada said it plans to auction on November 27 C$400 million of 4.25 percent real return bonds maturing on December 1, 2026.
The bonds, which will be dated and delivered on December 6, pay interest on June 1 and December 1.
Proceeds of the issue will be used for general purposes. They will be issued with accrued inflation compensation from December 7, 1995 and accrued interest from December 1, 1996.
The reference consumer price index base is 133.88065, and the index ratio on December 6 will be 1.01544.
The bonds are in addition to C$1.45 billion of bonds due Dec 2026 already outstanding.
